headline: eOselia Issued 50 Billion Hryvnias in Loans: Who Most Often Buys Housing Under the State Mortgage
summary: Over almost four years, more than 28,000 Ukrainian families have bought homes through the state eOselia affordable mortgage program, which has issued UAH 50 billion in loans.
why: State-backed mortgage programmes shape housing demand and bank lending volumes. They matter to banks and the construction sector in Ukraine.
